headline: The peculiar way Luis Caputo chose to deny his alleged resignation as Minister of Economy
summary: Argentina's Economy Minister Luis Caputo publicly ruled out reports that he would leave the Cabinet, responding ironically to a user on X.
why: The Economy Minister leads fiscal and monetary policy in Argentina, so changes in the post can affect investor expectations about the country's economic programme.
